items.title: Danny Barker Interview, 1959-06-30
items.q: Well it was John Marrera... They were terrific. And... John Marrera basically played, you know, the beat. Real great.

ctx.x: Let's get back down to New Orleans. What was the first music you remember hearing any music, a song, or anything like that?

The first music I remember hearing was my grandmother's voice. Singing while she's done a work around the house in the kitchen. Singing such great classical as, Down by the Riverside, May Lay a Monk Bilinger. That's what Jesus said. They don't know how they found John from Johnson's words, and he said, Down by the Riverside, I'm going to lay my weapons down.
